verdict.rationale: Google Cloud's REST method reference pages embed the APIs Explorer, a side panel with an Execute button that lets users try API methods without writing code. Machine-readable Discovery Documents back the reference. Coverage is partial because the evidence describes ad-hoc method execution rather than prebuilt runnable code examples, and the Explorer runs against real data with no sandbox mode. missing for 10: documented prebuilt runnable code examples within the reference, a sandboxed or test-data mode for safe execution, independent or hands-on corroboration of the interactive experience.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: lets you try Google API methods without writing code
The APIs Explorer acts on real data, so use caution when trying methods that create, modify, or delete data
a machine-readable \"Discovery Document\" for each API
